instruments.name: Mastcam-Z Multispectral Stereo Imaging System
instruments.description: Mast-mounted dual-camera stereo imaging suite with zoom capability to examine panoramic terrain and mineralogy.

instruments.name: SuperCam Laser Induced Breakdown Spectrometer
instruments.description: Fires pulsed laser beams at rock targets up to 7 meters away to vaporize target surfaces and analyze atomic emission spectra.

instruments.name: PIXL Planetary Instrument for X-ray Lithochemistry
instruments.description: Arm-mounted micro-focus X-ray fluorescence spectrometer that maps chemical elemental variations on target rocks down to sub-millimeter scales.

instruments.name: SHERLOC UV Raman & Fluorescence Spectrometer
instruments.description: Deep UV resonance Raman and fluorescence spectrometer designed to detect past organic molecules and potential biosignatures.

instruments.name: MOXIE Mars Oxygen ISRU Experiment
instruments.description: Solid oxide electrolysis cell that converts atmospheric carbon dioxide into breathable oxygen and rocket oxidizer propellant.

instruments.name: RIMFAX Radar Imager for Mars' Subsurface Experiment
instruments.description: Ground-penetrating radar profiling geological layers and potential buried water ice structures up to 10 meters depth.

instruments.name: MEDA Mars Environmental Dynamics Analyzer
instruments.description: Sensor suite measuring wind speed and direction, atmospheric pressure, relative humidity, air and surface temperatures, and dust optical depth.
